mechanics.sample_receiver: Each scalar sample calls 0x009360d0 with ECX set to the live x86-32 constant 0x01601760.
mechanics.sample_transform: For each of x, y, and z, transform the sample with sample plus sample minus one and clamp the transformed value to the inclusive range [-1, 1].
mechanics.retry: Compute norm as z squared plus x squared plus y squared. Reject and draw another complete triple when norm is greater than one or less than 0.0001. The exact one and 0.0001 boundaries are accepted.
mechanics.final_normalization: After acceptance, compute one divided by the square root of norm, multiply x, y, and z by that inverse, and store the results at direction+0, +4, and +8.
mechanics.output_identity: The output pointer is read once and all three output stores use that pointer. There is no null check and no return value.
mechanics.side_effect_boundary: The only memory writes are the three final float stores. The render sample service is an opaque unresolved random source.
